title: Moore: Benowitz operation as a 24-hour stage play
place_text: Kirtland Air Force Base, New Mexico

tellings.quote: imagine the Benowitz operation as a 24-hour long stage play.

plain: The effort around a man named Bennewitz near Kirtland Air Force Base in New Mexico, in the 1970s and early 80s, is said to have worked like a 24-hour stage play, a show staged around the clock for one audience. A guest named Greg Bishop tells Michels that a UFO researcher named Bill Moore described it this way, and Bishop also draws on a man named Harry Rositzke. If so, what Bennewitz saw and heard would have been put on for him on purpose.
